metadata.description: Skills from Aiko. They work without the app; with Aiko they come and go with its personality.

plugins.name: aiko-copy
plugins.description: UI text, READMEs and release notes that read as written by a person. Russian and English.

plugins.name: aiko-docs-hygiene
plugins.description: Keep project documents honest: a state file rebuilt from measured facts, an append-only decision log, and an audit for duplicates and contradictions.

plugins.name: aiko-release-gate
plugins.description: A release check before shipping: GO or NO-GO, irreversible changes named, rollout order and rollback plan. Nothing is pushed.

plugins.name: aiko-glb-for-web
plugins.description: A Blender model as a .glb that web players show correctly, with an offline checker for size and unsupported extensions.

plugins.name: aiko-blender-to-unity
plugins.description: Meshes from Blender into Unity without mirrored or rotated surprises: pose, FBX settings, the measured axis rule, blended normals, cut shared parts.

plugins.name: aiko-texturing
plugins.description: Texture sizes from the game camera: pixels per metre from the screen, sheet or tile, UVs from world position, guides for painters, density measured per face.

plugins.name: aiko-palette
plugins.description: Check colours against a palette and fix them with the smallest change, in OKLCH. Offline, no key.

plugins.name: aiko-gamedesign-research
plugins.description: One game mechanic across 30-40 games: an illustrated review with sources, then interactive stands to play with the systems.
